svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Introduction to Kubernetes, slide 3 of 12: The cluster: brain and workers
svg.desc: The cluster: the control plane is the manager (API server, scheduler, controller manager and etcd; on GKE Google runs it) and kubectl on your laptop talks only to the API server; three worker nodes are the cooks, each with kubelet, containerd and kube-proxy, running the pods.
svg.text: The control plane decides, the worker nodes do the work: a restaurant’s manager and its cooks.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
